0.name: TEXT_CTSETCAOZMARTYNTALK_00846_MARTYN_000_000
0.description: To be a blue mage, you need to go and discover things for yourself! You'll be doin' a fair bit of walkin', too, so it might be worth investin' in a sturdier pair of boots at some point.

1.name: TEXT_CTSETCAOZMARTYNTALK_00846_MARTYN_000_010
1.description: Let me tell you somethin', <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. There are more important things in life than money. I once knew a man who forgot that, and─well, never you mind. Just remember what I said.

2.name: TEXT_CTSETCAOZMARTYNTALK_00846_MARTYN_000_020
2.description: Gods, nobody annoys me more than Whastrach. We were what you might call “friends” at one point, but even then, he always looked down on me.

3.name: TEXT_CTSETCAOZMARTYNTALK_00846_MARTYN_000_030
3.description: Hello, mate! How's the spellbook comin' along? Filled it up yet?

4.name: TEXT_CTSETCAOZMARTYNTALK_00846_MARTYN_000_031
4.description: As for your performances, if you keep this up, you'll have nearly as many fans as me!

5.name: TEXT_CTSETCAOZMARTYNTALK_00846_MARTYN_000_040
5.description: I thought the clear blue skies of Ishgard would be the perfect backdrop for learnin' some blue magic, but when I got there, I was in the middle of a bleedin' snowstorm! Still, I'd say it was character buildin', if nothin' else.

6.name: TEXT_CTSETCAOZMARTYNTALK_00846_MARTYN_000_050
6.description: Those novices seem to have really taken a shine to you. Don't let all that admiration go to your head, though!

7.name: TEXT_CTSETCAOZMARTYNTALK_00846_MARTYN_000_060
7.description: Do you reckon my blue magic'll be able to get through Siegfried's defenses? I suppose I could try cookin' him in his own armor with a bit of Flame Thrower!

8.name: TEXT_CTSETCAOZMARTYNTALK_00846_MARTYN_000_070
8.description: I'll tell you what, I'm lookin' forward to gettin' this match over and done with, one way or another. It's all the waitin' around before that I can't stand!

9.name: TEXT_CTSETCAOZMARTYNTALK_00846_MARTYN_000_080
9.description: Looks like it's all down to you now. One bit of advice: I'd give Self-destruct a miss if I were you. That spell's more trouble than it's worth!

10.name: TEXT_CTSETCAOZMARTYNTALK_00846_MARTYN_000_090
10.description: How goes the blue magin'? Got yourself any new spells?

11.name: TEXT_CTSETCAOZMARTYNTALK_00846_MARTYN_000_091
11.description: As for me, I've been busy tryin' to make a <hex:021A020203>new<hex:021A020103> name for myself as Azuro the Third. I don't think they've figured out it's still the same old me, though. I did consider gettin' a new costume, but these things cost money, you know.

12.name: TEXT_CTSETCAOZMARTYNTALK_00846_MARTYN_000_100
12.description: You can do this, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! Gogo might be one monster of a mimic, but he can't copy your instinct for combat. Let's see him contend with a true master of the blue!

13.name: TEXT_CTSETCAOZMARTYNTALK_00846_MARTYN_000_110
13.description: Well, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>? You been chasin' down all those untapped wonders we talked about? There's so much blue magic out there still left to learn.

14.name: TEXT_CTSETCAOZMARTYNTALK_00846_MARTYN_000_111
14.description: I don't know about you, but I'd like to see just how far Azuro the Second can take this art of ours!

15.name: TEXT_CTSETCAOZMARTYNTALK_00846_MARTYN_000_120
15.description: I haven't a mean bone in my body, yet somehow Royse expects me to take on a dark persona to play your nemesis. Hopefully she knows what she's doing.

16.name: TEXT_CTSETCAOZMARTYNTALK_00846_MARTYN_000_130
16.description: Well, well, well... If it isn't my old nemesis... <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>.<hex:02100103>Ahem. Still tryin' to wrap my head around this villainous banter, but don't you worry─I'll get it eventually.

18.name: TEXT_CTSETCAOZMARTYNTALK_00846_MARTYN_000_150
18.description: The potential of blue magic is without limit, and I've no doubt you'll make the most of it.

19.name: TEXT_CTSETCAOZMARTYNTALK_00846_MARTYN_000_151
19.description: So keep explorin', seek new knowledge, and show the world why they call you Azuro the Second!
